title: Ezekiel Bible Quiz - Chapter 42
description: Ten questions on Ezekiel 42: the rooms by the separate place, the holy rooms of the priests, and the wall of five hundred by five hundred.

questions.text: Into which court was the prophet brought first in this chapter, by the way toward the north?
questions.explanation: He was brought out into the outer court, the way toward the north, and then into the room opposite the separate place.

questions.text: Which door stood before the length of one hundred cubits?
questions.explanation: Before the length of one hundred cubits was the north door, and the width was fifty cubits.

questions.text: What lay before the rooms, inward?
questions.explanation: Before the rooms was a walk of ten cubits' width inward, a way of one cubit, and their doors were toward the north.

answers.text: A walk of ten cubits' width

questions.text: In how many stories were these rooms, and what did they lack?
questions.explanation: They were in three stories, and they did not have pillars like the pillars of the courts.

answers.text: Two stories, with pillars of stone
Three stories, with pillars like the courts
Three stories, without pillars like the courts

questions.text: How long was the wall outside, by the side of the rooms toward the outer court?
questions.explanation: The wall that was outside by the side of the rooms, toward the outer court before the rooms, was fifty cubits long.

questions.text: On which side was the entry from under these rooms, as one goes in from the outer court?
questions.explanation: From under these rooms was the entry on the east side, as one goes into them from the outer court.

questions.text: What are the north rooms and the south rooms before the separate place called?
questions.explanation: He said that the north rooms and the south rooms before the separate place are the holy rooms, where the priests who are near to Yahweh shall eat the most holy things.

questions.text: What must the priests do with their garments before they approach that which is for the people?
questions.explanation: The priests shall lay the garments in which they minister in the holy place, and put on other garments, before they approach that which is for the people.

answers.text: Wash them in the sea before leaving
Lay them there and put on other garments
Burn them in the inner court

questions.text: How much did he measure on the east side with the measuring reed?
questions.explanation: He measured on the east side with the measuring reed five hundred reeds, with the measuring reed all around.

questions.text: What was the purpose of the wall around the whole area, five hundred by five hundred?
questions.explanation: It had a wall around it, five hundred long and five hundred wide, to make a separation between that which was holy and that which was common.

answers.text: To separate the holy from the common
